findings.issue: «toda congregación» without article is distributive (every congregation). כל with the determined construct עדת בני־ישראל licenses one whole congregation.
Niphal sequential imperfect 3mp is smoothed to singular murmuró with the singular subject congregación; the murmuring party is still that congregation.
desde matches the preposition מן, but mañana also means morning, so the morrow/following-day sense is less explicit.

notes: Jehová, Moisés, Aarón, Israel, ustedes, and hiphil mataron match the tokens.
